stories.headline: Flood revives Malarikkal’s pink bloom
stories.title: Flood revives Malarikkal’s pink bloom
stories.summary: As visitors flock to witness the annual water lily season, which is expected to last until early October, local economies are benefiting, with increased demand for boat tours and homestays. By 6 a.m., boats carrying tourists begin heading into the lily-filled polders, where the flowers remain in full bloom until around 9 a.m.
